KNOW #1 📚 Pip Kya Hota Hai?
Forex me sab pips me baat karte hain. Pip asal me hai kya?
• Pip matlab price ka sabse chhota standard move.
• EURUSD me 1 pip = 0.0001, yaani 4th decimal.
• JPY pairs me 1 pip = 0.01, 2nd decimal.
Tip: profit pips me nahi, apne risk ke hisaab se gino.
